requirements.title: GOVERN
requirements.description: The organization's cybersecurity risk management strategy, expectations, and policy are established, communicated, and monitored

requirements.title: Organizational Context
requirements.description: The circumstances - mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies, and legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements - surrounding the organization's cybersecurity risk management decisions are understood

requirements.title: GV.OC-01
requirements.description: The organizational mission is understood and informs cybersecurity risk management

requirements.title: GV.OC-02
requirements.description: Internal and external stakeholders are understood, and their needs and expectations regarding cybersecurity risk management are understood and considered

requirements.title: GV.OC-03
requirements.description: Legal, regulatory, and contractual requirements regarding cybersecurity - including privacy and civil liberties obligations - are understood and managed

requirements.title: GV.OC-04
requirements.description: Critical objectives, capabilities, and services that external stakeholders depend on or expect from the organization are understood and communicated

requirements.title: GV.OC-05
requirements.description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that the organization depends on are understood and communicated

requirements.title: Risk Management Strategy
requirements.description: The organization's priorities, constraints, risk tolerance and appetite statements, and assumptions are established, communicated, and used to support operational risk decisions

requirements.title: GV.RM-01
requirements.description: Risk management objectives are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

requirements.title: GV.RM-02
requirements.description: Risk appetite and risk tolerance statements are established, communicated, and maintained

requirements.title: GV.RM-03
requirements.description: Cybersecurity risk management activities and outcomes are included in enterprise risk management processes

requirements.title: GV.RM-04
requirements.description: Strategic direction that describes appropriate risk response options is established and communicated

requirements.title: GV.RM-05
requirements.description: Lines of communication across the organization are established for cybersecurity risks, including risks from suppliers and other third parties

requirements.title: GV.RM-06
requirements.description: A standardized method for calculating, documenting, categorizing, and prioritizing cybersecurity risks is established and communicated

requirements.title: GV.RM-07
requirements.description: Strategic opportunities (i.e., positive risks) are characterized and are included in organizational cybersecurity risk discussions

requirements.title: Roles, Responsibilities, and Authorities
requirements.description: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities, and authorities to foster accountability, performance assessment, and continuous improvement are established and communicated

requirements.title: GV.RR-01
requirements.description: Organizational leadership is responsible and accountable for cybersecurity risk and fosters a culture that is risk-aware, ethical, and continually improving

requirements.title: GV.RR-02
requirements.description: Roles, responsibilities, and authorities related to cybersecurity risk management are established, communicated, understood, and enforced

requirements.title: GV.RR-03
requirements.description: Adequate resources are allocated commensurate with the cybersecurity risk strategy, roles, responsibilities, and policies

requirements.title: GV.RR-04
requirements.description: Cybersecurity is included in human resources practices

requirements.title: Policy
requirements.description: Organizational cybersecurity policy is established, communicated, and enforced

requirements.title: GV.PO-01
requirements.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is established based on organizational context, cybersecurity strategy, and priorities and is communicated and enforced

requirements.title: GV.PO-02
requirements.description: Policy for managing cybersecurity risks is reviewed, updated, communicated, and enforced to reflect changes in requirements, threats, technology, and organizational mission

requirements.title: Oversight
requirements.description: Results of organization-wide cybersecurity risk management activities and performance are used to inform, improve, and adjust the risk management strategy

requirements.title: GV.OV-01
requirements.description: Cybersecurity risk management strategy outcomes are reviewed to inform and adjust strategy and direction

requirements.title: GV.OV-02
requirements.description: The cybersecurity risk management strategy is reviewed and adjusted to ensure coverage of organizational requirements and risks

requirements.title: GV.OV-03
requirements.description: Organizational cybersecurity risk management performance is evaluated and reviewed for adjustments needed

requirements.title: Cybersecurity Supply Chain Risk Management
requirements.description: Cyber supply chain risk management processes are identified, established, managed, monitored, and improved by organizational stakeholders

requirements.title: GV.SC-01
requirements.description: A cybersecurity supply chain risk management program, strategy, objectives, policies, and processes are established and agreed to by organizational stakeholders

requirements.title: GV.SC-02
requirements.description: Cybersecurity roles and responsibilities for suppliers, customers, and partners are established, communicated, and coordinated internally and externally

requirements.title: GV.SC-03
requirements.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management is integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management, risk assessment, and improvement processes

requirements.title: GV.SC-04
requirements.description: Suppliers are known and prioritized by criticality

requirements.title: GV.SC-05
requirements.description: Requirements to address cybersecurity risks in supply chains are established, prioritized, and integrated into contracts and other types of agreements with suppliers and other relevant third parties

requirements.title: GV.SC-06
requirements.description: Planning and due diligence are performed to reduce risks before entering into formal supplier or other third-party relationships

requirements.title: GV.SC-07
requirements.description: The risks posed by a supplier, their products and services, and other third parties are understood, recorded, prioritized, assessed, responded to, and monitored over the course of the relationship

requirements.title: GV.SC-08
requirements.description: Relevant suppliers and other third parties are included in incident planning, response, and recovery activities

requirements.title: GV.SC-09
requirements.description: Supply chain security practices are integrated into cybersecurity and enterprise risk management programs, and their performance is monitored throughout the technology product and service life cycle

requirements.title: GV.SC-10
requirements.description: Cybersecurity supply chain risk management plans include provisions for activities that occur after the conclusion of a partnership or service agreement

requirements.title: IDENTIFY
requirements.description: The organization's current cybersecurity risks are understood

requirements.title: Asset Management
requirements.description: Assets (e.g., data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services, people) that enable the organization to achieve business purposes are identified and managed consistent with their relative importance to organizational objectives and the organization's risk strategy

requirements.title: ID.AM-01
requirements.description: Inventories of hardware managed by the organization are maintained

requirements.title: ID.AM-02
requirements.description: Inventories of software, services, and systems managed by the organization are maintained

requirements.title: ID.AM-03
requirements.description: Representations of the organization's authorized network communication and internal and external network data flows are maintained

requirements.title: ID.AM-04
requirements.description: Inventories of services provided by suppliers are maintained

requirements.title: ID.AM-05
requirements.description: Assets are prioritized based on classification, criticality, resources, and impact on the mission

requirements.title: ID.AM-07
requirements.description: Inventories of data and corresponding metadata for designated data types are maintained

requirements.title: ID.AM-08
requirements.description: Systems, hardware, software, services, and data are managed throughout their life cycles

requirements.title: Risk Assessment
requirements.description: The cybersecurity risk to the organization, assets, and individuals is understood by the organization

requirements.title: ID.RA-01
requirements.description: Vulnerabilities in assets are identified, validated, and recorded

requirements.title: ID.RA-02
requirements.description: Cyber threat intelligence is received from information sharing forums and sources

requirements.title: ID.RA-03
requirements.description: Internal and external threats to the organization are identified and recorded

requirements.title: ID.RA-04
requirements.description: Potential impacts and likelihoods of threats exploiting vulnerabilities are identified and recorded

requirements.title: ID.RA-05
requirements.description: Threats, vulnerabilities, likelihoods, and impacts are used to understand inherent risk and inform risk response prioritization

requirements.title: ID.RA-06
requirements.description: Risk responses are chosen, prioritized, planned, tracked, and communicated

requirements.title: ID.RA-07
requirements.description: Changes and exceptions are managed, assessed for risk impact, recorded, and tracked

requirements.title: ID.RA-08
requirements.description: Processes for receiving, analyzing, and responding to vulnerability disclosures are established

requirements.title: ID.RA-09
requirements.description: The authenticity and integrity of hardware and software are assessed prior to acquisition and use

requirements.title: ID.RA-10
requirements.description: Critical suppliers are assessed prior to acquisition

requirements.title: Improvement
requirements.description: Improvements to organizational cybersecurity risk management processes, procedures and activities are identified across all CSF Functions

requirements.title: ID.IM-01
requirements.description: Improvements are identified from evaluations

requirements.title: ID.IM-02
requirements.description: Improvements are identified from security tests and exercises, including those done in coordination with suppliers and relevant third parties

requirements.title: ID.IM-03
requirements.description: Improvements are identified from execution of operational processes, procedures, and activities

requirements.title: ID.IM-04
requirements.description: Incident response plans and other cybersecurity plans that affect operations are established, communicated, maintained, and improved

requirements.title: PROTECT
requirements.description: Safeguards to manage the organization's cybersecurity risks are used

requirements.title: Identity Management, Authentication, and Access Control
requirements.description: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services, and hardware and  managed commensurate with the assessed risk of unauthorized access

requirements.title: PR.AA-01
requirements.description: Identities and credentials for authorized users, services, and hardware are managed by the organization

requirements.title: PR.AA-02
requirements.description: Identities are proofed and bound to credentials based on the context of interactions

requirements.title: PR.AA-03
requirements.description: Users, services, and hardware are authenticated

requirements.title: PR.AA-04
requirements.description: Identity assertions are protected, conveyed, and verified

requirements.title: PR.AA-05
requirements.description: Access permissions, entitlements, and authorizations are defined in a policy, managed, enforced, and reviewed, and incorporate the principles of least privilege and separation of duties

requirements.title: PR.AA-06
requirements.description: Physical access to assets is managed, monitored, and enforced commensurate with risk

requirements.title: Awareness and Training
requirements.description: The organization's personnel are provided with cybersecurity awareness and training so that they can perform their cybersecurity-related tasks

requirements.title: PR.AT-01
requirements.description: Personnel are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform general tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

requirements.title: PR.AT-02
requirements.description: Individuals in specialized roles are provided with awareness and training so that they possess the knowledge and skills to perform relevant tasks with cybersecurity risks in mind

requirements.title: Data Security
requirements.description: Data are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information

requirements.title: PR.DS-01
requirements.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-at-rest are protected

requirements.title: PR.DS-02
requirements.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-transit are protected

requirements.title: PR.DS-10
requirements.description: The confidentiality, integrity, and availability of data-in-use are protected

requirements.title: PR.DS-11
requirements.description: Backups of data are created, protected, maintained, and tested

requirements.title: Platform Security
requirements.description: The hardware, software (e.g., firmware, operating systems, applications), and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed consistent with the organization's risk strategy to protect their confidentiality, integrity, and availability

requirements.title: PR.PS-01
requirements.description: Configuration management practices are established and applied

requirements.title: PR.PS-02
requirements.description: Software is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

requirements.title: PR.PS-03
requirements.description: Hardware is maintained, replaced, and removed commensurate with risk

requirements.title: PR.PS-04
requirements.description: Log records are generated and made available for continuous monitoring

requirements.title: PR.PS-05
requirements.description: Installation and execution of unauthorized software are prevented

requirements.title: PR.PS-06
requirements.description: Secure software development practices are integrated, and their performance is monitored throughout the software development life cycle

requirements.title: Technology Infrastructure Resilience
requirements.description: Security architectures are managed with the organization's risk strategy to protect asset confidentiality, integrity, and availability, and organizational resilience

requirements.title: PR.IR-01
requirements.description: Networks and environments are protected from unauthorized logical access and usage

requirements.title: PR.IR-02
requirements.description: The organization's technology assets are protected from environmental threats

requirements.title: PR.IR-03
requirements.description: Mechanisms are implemented to achieve resilience requirements in normal and adverse situations

requirements.title: PR.IR-04
requirements.description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is maintained

requirements.title: DETECT
requirements.description: Possible cybersecurity attacks and compromises are found and analyzed

requirements.title: Continuous Monitoring
requirements.description: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events

requirements.title: DE.CM-01
requirements.description: Networks and network services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

requirements.title: DE.CM-02
requirements.description: The physical environment is monitored to find potentially adverse events

requirements.title: DE.CM-03
requirements.description: Personnel activity and technology usage are monitored to find potentially adverse events

requirements.title: DE.CM-06
requirements.description: External service provider activities and services are monitored to find potentially adverse events

requirements.title: DE.CM-09
requirements.description: Computing hardware and software, runtime environments, and their data are monitored to find potentially adverse events

requirements.title: Adverse Event Analysis
requirements.description: Anomalies, indicators of compromise, and other potentially adverse events are analyzed to characterize the events and detect cybersecurity incidents

requirements.title: DE.AE-02
requirements.description: Potentially adverse events are analyzed to better understand associated activities

requirements.title: DE.AE-03
requirements.description: Information is correlated from multiple sources

requirements.title: DE.AE-04
requirements.description: The estimated impact and scope of adverse events are understood

requirements.title: DE.AE-06
requirements.description: Information on adverse events is provided to authorized staff and tools

requirements.title: DE.AE-07
requirements.description: Cyber threat intelligence and other contextual information are integrated into the analysis

requirements.title: DE.AE-08
requirements.description: Incidents are declared when adverse events meet the defined incident criteria

requirements.title: RESPOND
requirements.description: Actions regarding a detected cybersecurity incident are taken

requirements.title: Incident Management
requirements.description: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed

requirements.title: RS.MA-01
requirements.description: The incident response plan is executed in coordination with relevant third parties once an incident is declared

requirements.title: RS.MA-02
requirements.description: Incident reports are triaged and validated

requirements.title: RS.MA-03
requirements.description: Incidents are categorized and prioritized

requirements.title: RS.MA-04
requirements.description: Incidents are escalated or elevated as needed

requirements.title: RS.MA-05
requirements.description: The criteria for initiating incident recovery are applied

requirements.title: Incident Analysis
requirements.description: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and support forensics and recovery activities

requirements.title: RS.AN-03
requirements.description: Analysis is performed to establish what has taken place during an incident and the root cause of the incident

requirements.title: RS.AN-06
requirements.description: Actions performed during an investigation are recorded, and the records' integrity and provenance are preserved

requirements.title: RS.AN-07
requirements.description: Incident data and metadata are collected, and their integrity and provenance are preserved

requirements.title: RS.AN-08
requirements.description: An incident's magnitude is estimated and validated

requirements.title: Incident Response Reporting and Communication
requirements.description: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders as required by laws, regulations, or policies

requirements.title: RS.CO-02
requirements.description: Internal and external stakeholders are notified of incidents

requirements.title: RS.CO-03
requirements.description: Information is shared with designated internal and external stakeholders

requirements.title: Incident Mitigation
requirements.description: Activities are performed to prevent expansion of an event and mitigate its effects

requirements.title: RS.MI-01
requirements.description: Incidents are contained

requirements.title: RS.MI-02
requirements.description: Incidents are eradicated

requirements.title: RECOVER
requirements.description: Assets and operations affected by a cybersecurity incident are restored

requirements.title: Incident Recovery Plan Execution
requirements.description: Restoration activities are performed to ensure operational availability of systems and services affected by cybersecurity incidents

requirements.title: RC.RP-01
requirements.description: The recovery portion of the incident response plan is executed once initiated from the incident response process

requirements.title: RC.RP-02
requirements.description: Recovery actions are selected, scoped, prioritized, and performed

requirements.title: RC.RP-03
requirements.description: The integrity of backups and other restoration assets is verified before using them for restoration

requirements.title: RC.RP-04
requirements.description: Critical mission functions and cybersecurity risk management are considered to establish post-incident operational norms

requirements.title: RC.RP-05
requirements.description: The integrity of restored assets is verified, systems and services are restored, and normal operating status is confirmed

requirements.title: RC.RP-06
requirements.description: The end of incident recovery is declared based on criteria, and incident-related documentation is completed

requirements.title: Incident Recovery Communication
requirements.description: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties

requirements.title: RC.CO-03
requirements.description: Recovery activities and progress in restoring operational capabilities are communicated to designated internal and external stakeholders

requirements.title: RC.CO-04
requirements.description: Public updates on incident recovery are shared using approved methods and messaging
